description:
List campaign review history

Returns observed review-state changes for an organization-owned campaign, ordered newest first. Navigate the result with pageSize and pageToken. The history records changes already observed by Photon; it does not initiate a new review or resubmit the campaign. Supply organization_id for the organization that owns the registration.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/10dlc-campaigns/list-campaign-review-history
name: listTenDlcCampaignReviewHistory

attemptNumber.description: The local submission or resubmission attempt associated with this observation; null when unknown.

message.description: Photon guidance for this campaign failure. Unrecognized failures receive a generic Photon support message.

occurredAt.description: When the event occurred, if reported; null when the original event time is unknown.

result.description:
The result of this individual step, not overall campaign approval.

Known values: ["pending","succeeded","failed"]. Others may be added.

step.description:
The individual step observed in this history entry.

Known values: ["registration","compliance_review","carrier_processing","carrier_activation"]. Others may be added.

title.description: A description of this specific milestone.

title: List campaign review history
